faq.question: After earning a bachelor's degree in India, are Indian students able to pursue postgraduate studies in civil engineering in Canada?
faq.answer: Yes . Indian students may apply if they match the standards of the chosen university in terms of their undergraduate degree, academic standing, required courses, and English language competency.

faq.question: How long does a postgraduate course in civil engineering take in Canada?
faq.answer: The duration of many master's programs is between one and two years. The length may vary depending on unique university requirements, co-ops, and research-based programs.

faq.question: Is the GRE required for a Canadian master's degree in civil engineering?
faq.answer: No. Each program and university has different GRE requirements. While some programs may mandate it or suggest it for specific candidates, others may not.

faq.question: How much does a masters degree in civil engineering cost in Canada?
faq.answer: International tuition, without living expenses, might cost anywhere from CAD 20,000 to CAD 60,000 or more annually. The university, program, and location all affect actual prices.

faq.question: After earning a postgraduate degree in civil engineering, may I get employment in Canada?
faq.answer: A Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) may be available to some graduates, contingent on the program, school, academic background, and current IRCC regulations. A work permit, job, or permanent residence are not always assured by a Canadian degree.
